chunks: Ibn Abī Najrān and ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam narrated from Ṣafwān al-Jammāl, who said:
I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about zakat al-fiṭrah.
He said: “It is upon the young and the old, the free and the enslaved. For every person, one sāʿ of wheat, or one sāʿ of dates, or one sāʿ of raisins.”

key_terms.صَاعٌ: a sāʿ, a standard measure for food-giving
key_terms.ٱلْفِطْرَةِ: zakat al-fiṭrah, the alms due at the end of Ramadan

ai.seo_question: Who must pay zakat al-fiṭrah, and how much is due per person?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal obligation of zakat al-fiṭrah for all individuals, including the young and old, free and enslaved. It also specifies the amount due per person as one sāʿ of staple food, such as wheat, dates, or raisins. The narration is a concise fiqh text on the scope and measure of fiṭrah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2061 - It is narrated from Ibn Abi Najran and Ali ibn Al-Hakam, from Safwan Al-Jammal, who said:
"I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about Zakat al-Fitr.
Imam (as) said: 'It is obligatory for the young and the old, the free and the enslaved. For every individual, it is one sa' (measure) of wheat, or one sa' of dates, or one sa' of raisins.'"
